label: preparing
what: A coordinated evening gathering/community meal in the town hall great hall at eighteen hundred, apparently intended to welcome or surprise the mayor. The meal and appointment have been disclosed, but the particulars and private coordination have been withheld. Innkeeper coordinates with Freight and builder; baker's involvement is suggested by receiving a lantern from innkeeper, though less certain. Secretary manages the mayor's timing and requests no early arrival; neighbour explicitly kept an earlier conversation private and will welcome the mayor.
